{"id": "fef2d427-4caa-4c5b-a7c1-ae0b59239af1", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Yes, the storage grows with no limit, but at your current volume it costs almost nothing.

**What I found**
- Bedrock invocation logs go only to the CloudWatch log group `/llmops-demo/bedrock-invocations`. No S3 bucket is configured.
- The log group has no retention policy, so logs are never deleted.
- The log group was created around mid-October 2026 and holds about 127 MB (127,197,809 bytes) in the Standard class.
- That works out to roughly 3 MB a day, or about 1 GB a year if usage stays flat.

**Cost at this size (approximate us-east-1 list prices)**
- Storage is about $0.03 per GB-month, so the 127 MB costs roughly $0.004 a month.
- Ingestion is about $0.50 per GB, so everything logged so far cost around $0.06.
- The cost only becomes noticeable if invocation volume or prompt size grows a lot. Text delivery and video delivery are both enabled, and logging full prompts and responses can scale quickly with traffic.

Setting a retention period on the log group (for example 30, 90 or 365 days) stops the growth. I can apply that if you tell me how long you need to keep the logs. If you need them longer for audit or analytics, exporting to S3 with a lifecycle rule is the cheaper long-term option. Each change needs your approval before it runs.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
